name: gramps-web-mcp
description: MCP server for Gramps Web. Gives AI agents structured, tool-based access to family trees through the Model Context Protocol. Built with .NET 10.

paragraphs: Update to 2.3.1 or later. Before 2.3.1 the update tools could drop stored data that the call did not mention (#5). If you edited a tree with an earlier version, check it for dropped data.
Companion MCP server for the Gramps Web open-source genealogy platform. It gives AI agents structured, tool-based access to family trees through the Model Context Protocol.

This project is not a standalone genealogy UI or replacement for Gramps Web. Run it alongside an existing Gramps Web instance; your users, trees, media, permissions, and genealogy editing UI stay in Gramps Web.
features: Up to 30 MCP tools — read, create, update, and delete people, families, events, places,
sources, citations, notes, media, repositories, and tags
Search and browse — full-text search and paginated object listing
Kinship tools — ancestors, descendants, relationships, and timelines
Incremental links — add or remove one event, child, citation, or note

whatItDoes.text: Update to 2.3.1 or later. Before 2.3.1 the update tools could drop stored data that the call did not mention (#5). If you edited a tree with an earlier version, check it for dropped data.

requirements.text: The server starts with HTTP transport at No API key is required when binding to loopback only.
Probes reuse the token the tools use, so they do not log in to Gramps Web each time.
If Gramps Web has password login turned off (OIDCDISABLELOCALAUTH=true), set GRAMPSREFRESHTOKEN and leave GRAMPSUSERNAME and GRAMPSPASSWORD unset.
